title: Next Issue Dependency Queue
description: Singleton work-queue file for the /next-issue pipeline, created when an explicitly-named issue has open declared dependencies. Written to .claude/memory/tmp/next-issue-queue.json. Drives subsequent /next-issue runs toward the named target, resolving its open blockers first. Kept separate from the per-issue next-issue-{N}.json state (which /ship-issue deletes when a dependency ships) so the queue survives each dependency landing.

version.description: Schema version. Always 1 for the queue file.

target.description: The explicitly-named issue this queue is driving toward. Appears last in `ordered`.

ordered.description: Full topological work order, deepest blocker first and `target` last. Immutable record of the resolved dependency chain.

remaining.description: Not-yet-completed entries from `ordered`. Shrinks as dependencies close; when it reduces to just `target`, that issue is selected and the queue file is deleted.

active.description: The entry selected to work this cycle (the first open, unblocked issue in `remaining`).

created.description: ISO date when the queue was created (YYYY-MM-DD).
